notes.notes:
"Koi-Koi Ultimate Bundle" include "Koi-Koi Japan",
our new release DLC is "Koi-Koi Japan : Hana-Awase Rule Add-On".

Let's enjoy Hanafuda even more with a different way of playing from "Koi-Koi"!

This is one of the rules for playing Hanafuda with three people.
Some roles are different between "Koi-Koi" and "Hana-Awase".

For more about the game check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491860/]here[/url].

Thank you!

notes.title: Save now with the Bishoujo Battle Bundle!
notes.notes:
We recently launched a third exciting casual title featuring the bishoujo girls from "Rikku☆Jiasu" (Rick G Earth) mobile military turn-based strategy game from Japan. 

Also, we've upgraded the Bishoujo Battle Bundle to include all three! Buy all three games and get a special 20% off bundle discount. If you already had a chance to pick up either or both of our earlier Bishoujo Battle titles then this is your chance to complete the set at a great low price.
